subsystem: OOD gate (C15): frame-analyzability pre-analysis gate, 2x-speed playback gap

environment.notes: No pose extraction (Apple Vision is macOS-only); all signals here are pose-free by design, which is exactly the tier the mission targets.

mission: Close, or prove unclosable at the pose-free frame-statistic evidence tier, the documented 2x-speed OOD gap (oodGateRedTeam.test.ts KNOWN OPEN GAP): speed-resampled playback passes evaluateFrameAnalyzability.

datasetScope.tunePositivesNote: The only committed bundle clips that are not held out. wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were never read, decoded, or resampled.
datasetScope.speedVariants: 1.5x / 2x / 3x variants of each tune positive, built at experiment time with the exact red-team fixture recipe (ffmpeg -vf setpts=PTS/<factor> -r 30 -an); never committed.
datasetScope.verificationOnly: 16 fresh-candidate clips (datasets/pickleball/fresh-candidates/) measured strictly as the coverage floor: no threshold was fit to them; they only answer 'would a candidate discriminator falsely reject genuine footage'. No labels were created or used.
datasetScope.grouping: Per independent source clip; no random-frame splits. Analysis window bounded to the first 60s of each clip (deterministic prefix).

signals.motionMagnitude: inter-frame mean-abs-luma-diff distribution at 64x36 gray (mean, p50, p90, p99) — same raster the gate uses
signals.resamplingAliasing: diffAlternationIndex: mean |d[i]-d[i-1]| over the lag-1 diff series, normalized by mean diff
signals.interFrameTiming: container best-effort presentation-timestamp delta statistics (mean, std, cv) via ffprobe
signals.opticalFlowProxy: 8x8 block-matching velocity distribution at 128x72 gray, Chebyshev search radius 7, textured blocks only (spatial std > 4): p50/p90/p99 px/frame + search-saturation fraction

motionMagnitude_diffP50.why: Any threshold low enough to catch both 2x variants (<=1.97) also rejects genuine fresh-candidate footage at 3.28 and sits inside the genuine corpus range [0.10, 3.28].

opticalFlow_p99PxPerFrame.why: Genuine fast play (va-O1dLhGGPErc: p90=4.12, p99=8.6, saturation 0.053) exceeds both 2x variants (p99 4.0/7.0, saturation <=0.010) on every flow axis.

temporalSmoothness_lag2OverLag1.why: 2x values sit strictly inside the genuine range; multiple genuine clips (yt-o_NeuHjTEVE 1.675, yt-eK-iPN2XAJQ 1.682) fall between the two 2x variants.

resamplingAliasing_diffAlternationIndex.why: Integer-ratio resampling (30fps -> 2x -> 30fps) is exact frame decimation and leaves no aliasing signature; genuine clips voa-6115790 (1.068) and yt-tJuJ4MQdYy0 (1.634) exceed both 2x variants.

interFrameTiming_cv.why: ffmpeg -r 30 re-stamps output frames on a perfectly uniform 33.33ms grid — identical to a genuine constant-frame-rate capture. Timing statistics carry zero information about resampling.

metrics.falseRejectWitness: va-O1dLhGGPErc (fresh candidate, 24fps genuine pickleball footage) dominates the 2x variants on motion magnitude (diffP50 3.28 vs 2.29 max) and optical flow (p99 8.6 vs 7.0 max): every motion-scaled discriminator that catches 2x resampling rejects this legitimate clip.

findings.conclusion: PROVEN NEGATIVE at the pose-free frame-statistic tier: none of the five measured temporal signals (motion magnitude, temporal smoothness, resampling aliasing, inter-frame timing, block-matching optical flow) separates 2x speed-resampled playback from the genuine positive corpus without rejecting legitimate fast play.
findings.theoreticalCore: A 2x resample of a 30fps source to 30fps output is exact frame decimation: the output is pixel-identical to what a real camera would have produced filming the same scene at double speed. At any pose-free raster the discrimination problem reduces to 'is the motion fast?', and the genuine corpus already contains faster motion (va-O1dLhGGPErc) than the 2x variants of the committed dev clips. Non-integer ratios could in principle leave aliasing signatures, but the measured alternation index shows genuine footage spans and exceeds the resampled range.
findings.gateAction: None. evaluateFrameAnalyzability is unchanged; 'playback_speed' remains honestly declared in notEvaluated, and the oodGateRedTeam.test.ts KNOWN OPEN GAP test remains the documented contract. Closing this gap requires pose-conditioned evidence (e.g. joint-velocity plausibility against human kinematic limits), which is a different evidence tier and is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL on Linux (Apple Vision pose extraction unavailable).
findings.timingBugCaught: An initial run showed a spurious timing-cv separation (0.11-0.21 vs 0.017-0.10); root cause was a parsing bug in the experiment tool (blank ffprobe CSV lines coerced to timestamp 0). After the fix, cv = 0 for every clip. Recorded so the false lead is not rediscovered.
